question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Oppose
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'Favour.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Oppose
 to disagree with something, often by speaking or fighting against it. (किसी बात से असहमत होना, अक्सर बोलकर या उसके खिलाफ लड़कर)
 
 

 Favour
 the support or approval of something or someone. (किसी चीज या किसी का समर्थन या अनुमोदन)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Quarrel
 an angry disagreement between two or more people or groups. (दो या दो से अधिक लोगों या समूहों के बीच क्रोधित असहमति)
 
 

 Assist
 to help. (मदद)
 
 

 Control
 to order, limit, or rule something, or someone's actions or behaviour. (किसी चीज़ या किसी के कार्यों या व्यवहार को आदेश देना, सीमित करना या नियम बनाना)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Oppose' and 'Favour' are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 4.​​
